To expand on this a little bit, the decorator/enrober setup is almost the exact same as  on Sollich 3. The motor speed can be set from 0-300. If the motor speed is set to 300 on Sollich 3, it'll spin so fast you'd worry about the machine shaking itself apart. When we set the Sollich 1 decorator's motor speed to 300, it looks like it's in turtle-mode.
 
As for the pins not retracting, it appears to be a software issue. On Sollich 3, when you press the symbol in between the two buttons for the decorator motors, it brings up a window that says "Nozzle cleaning" (pictured), which is what retracts the pins from the nozzles when you press the "Start" button. And we are unable to bring up the same or similar window on Sollich 1, which means we cannot retract the pins and chocolate cannot be deposited, regardless of the motor speed.
